Satellite name IonSat (Ion-Sat)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organization Ecole Polytechnique
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation France
Partners ThrustMe, CNES
Costs Budget total estimate: 1.4 M€.
Oneliner

Demonstrate iodine thruster developed by ThrustMe.
Description

The mission is to put an ion thruster into orbit, to demonstrate it technologically and to study the effects of iodine deposits on the operation of the satellite. Propelled by an iodine NPT-30i miniaturized thruster developed by ThrustMe.
